[EN] Are you finding your feet in Arborea?

You’ll have to train hard to get used to your new surroundings quickly.

Do you want me to give you some training? "What have I got to do?"
[ES] ¿Te estás adaptando a Arborea?

Tendrás que entrenar duro para acostumbrarte rápido a tu nuevo entorno.

¿Quieres que te dé algo de entrenamiento? "What have I got to do?"

[EN] Excellent. If you use {@WorkObject:250001}, you’ll need to defeat the Shadow Warrior that appears. But it’s just a warm-up exercise.

You can come to me for training any time.
[ES] Excelente. Si usas {@WorkObject:250001}, tendrás que derrotar al Shadow Warrior que aparece. Pero es solo un ejercicio de calentamiento.

Puedes venir a verme para entrenar en cualquier momento.
